snippet.title: The Crew Motorfest: Season 7 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#TheCrewMotorfest Season 7 celebrates European Luxury excellence with #Ferrari in the spotlight.

Explore the new Enzo Ferrari Museum in Maui and take on the #FerrariSupercars Playlist, featuring the brand's most iconic supercars including the never seen before #FerrariF80. Starting August 6, the Luxury Chronicles: Europe Playlist brings even more legendary cars from brands like Porsche and Triumph. 

17 new vehicles, weekly events, and major quality-of-life updates also available in Season 7, available for FREE and all players on July 2nd in #TheCrewMotorfest

Play now in The Crew Motorfest. 
The Crew Motorfest is available on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Ubisoft Connect PC, Epic Games Store, Luna and is included in the Ubisoft+ subscription. Get the game now on: https://ubi.li/1DX4P
 
Transfer hundreds of cars from The Crew 2 to The Crew Motorfest for FREE with the Collection Import. More info here: https://ubi.li/rHcEZ

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate open-world driving experience. Explore the beautiful Hawaiiaan archipelago, from O'ahu to the newly-added Maui island, at the wheel of the most prestigious vehicles. Discover the best of car culture through intense races, themed events, unexpected challenges, and collect hundreds of iconic cars. Try the game for free for up to 5 hours!

#Ubisoft #TheCrew #TheCrewMotorfest
About Ubisoft:
Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences. Ubisoft’s global teams create and develop a deep and diverse portfolio of games, featuring brands such as Assassin’s Creed®, Brawlhalla®, For Honor®, Far Cry®, Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon®, Just Dance®, Rabbids®, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six®, The Crew® and Tom Clancy’s The Division®. With a Ubisoft+ subscription, players can access new releases, premium editions and extra content on Day One on PC, console and cloud. For the 2024-25 fiscal year, Ubisoft generated net bookings of €1.85 billion. To learn more, please visit: www.ubisoftgroup.com.
